title: Belmont News post front matter
description: Validates the YAML front matter block of every post file under content/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD/. The single source of truth for field-level validation. index.mjs reads this file and additionally enforces the repo gates that a single file cannot express: path shape, folder date equals date, byline matches the roster slug, slug uniqueness, and column ownership.

date.description: Publication day in America/New_York. Must equal the day folder in the path.

edition.description: Which edition this post belongs to.

column.description: Required by the index.mjs gate when edition is column. Must be a column owned by the byline in roster.json. A column has exactly one owner, so two roster entries must not list the same column.

byline.description: Full name exactly as registered in roster.json, capitalisation included. No shared bylines. The one desk line is 'Belmont News staff', for copy no single reporter files; it is not a substitute for a reporter's name. An entry marked retired in roster.json is archive-only: the gate refuses it for any post dated after its retirement day.

slug.description: URL slug, unique across the archive. The site URL is /<date>/<slug>/.

expires.description: Optional. The newsroom day, America/New_York, on which this post stops being listed on the site's rolling front page and in feed.xml. A plain calendar day and nothing else: a time of day is refused, because the newsroom changes offset on 2026-11-01 and a rule that picked one would be right for half the year. Omit this field and the post is listed for the two newsroom days counting its own, which is the site default and needs no field. This is a listing rule only: the post's own page stays live, stays at HTTP 200, keeps its sources, and stays in sitemap.xml after it expires. Expiring a listing is not a withdrawal and does not make any claim in the copy true. index.mjs additionally checks that this day is not before the post's own date.

sources.description: At least one source is required. An unsourced post fails the build.

type.description: document = on-record document. human = named human source, on the record.

title.description: Document title, or the person's name when type is human.

organization.description: Issuing body, or the person's affiliation when type is human.

corrections.description: Published corrections. A correction is appended, never a silent edit.
